headline: GM to Introduce Hybrid SUVs in Strategic Pivot From Pure EVs
summary: General Motors plans to offer hybrid SUVs in a strategic shift from its exclusive focus on electric vehicles.
why: Automakers adjust powertrain offerings to match shifting consumer adoption rates and regulatory conditions across vehicle segments.

impacts.name: General Motors Co
impacts.why: Adding hybrid options diversifies product lineups against uneven EV demand but requires capital reallocations.
